title: Q4 – Hybrid Search
summary: Combine relational filters with vector search.
description: True power comes from combining logic. In the Archive, we often need to filter by a category (like 'Astronomy') and then rank by semantic similarity. This is called Hybrid Search.
objective_text: Find the most similar 'Astronomy' fragment to the vector [0.9, 0.1, 0.1].

verification.query: SELECT fragment_id FROM historical_fragments WHERE category = 'Astronomy' ORDER BY embedding <=> '[0.9, 0.1, 0.1]'::vector LIMIT 1;
